title: A second session working in the same checkout is refused before it commits
goal: backlog.py claim records the claiming session's name and git toplevel under _cache (never committed) and refuses, naming the other session, a claim by another session in the same toplevel (the same working tree, not its own worktree); the kb-sprint and kb-item runbooks say each worker session works in its own worktree from its first command. A test plants two sessions claiming in one checkout and one in a worktree of it. Answers the SP-tpulmoxh and SP-xdzgepun retrospectives, where a worker's claim commit landed on another worker's branch in a shared checkout; it takes ST-qfw6o5fq's runbook clause.
